items.raw_excerpt: Pese a que la Delegación Presidencial de Valparaíso negó autorización para el carnaval de este fin de semana, de igual forma se va a realizar. Alcaldesa (s) señaló que la prohibición "es un error, porque expone a una situación de mayor riesgo".
items.summary_en: The Mil Tambores street carnival will take place this weekend in Valparaíso, even though officials denied permission. Neighbors have turned to the courts, and the city is asking the government for other options. The mayor said the ban is a mistake because it puts people at greater risk.

items.raw_excerpt: NAGOYA: Shannon Tan became the first Singaporean golfer to clinch an Asian Games medal on Saturday (Oct 3), taking bronze in the women’s individual event.At the Kasugai Country Club East Course, world No 59 Tan finished with a 14-under 266 total after recording a final round two-under 68.She finished
items.summary_en: Shannon Tan made history by becoming the first Singaporean golfer to win an Asian Games medal. She took bronze in the women's individual event at Kasugai Country Club near Nagoya, Japan. Tan finished with a total score of 266, 14 under par, after a final-round 68.
